locations.note: 7 December 1941: Joe wakes aboard the USS California to the Japanese attack and fights from a PT boat to defend Battleship Row.
January 1942: Joe and Gunny win back a captured demolition truck so the Calumpit Bridge can be blown, but Joe's brother Donnie is lost when his tank is overrun.
August 1942: Gunny and Joe raid Guadalcanal at midnight to take the airfield, and in October face the artillery of 'Pistol Pete'.
March 1943: Joe infiltrates an Axis summit in occupied Singapore in a stolen German uniform.
April 1944: Joe, Tanaka and Bromley hunt Shima's gold-smelting temples in Burma and rescue their downed Flying Tigers pilot.
July 1944: Joe falls from the plane over Thailand and blows up a train loaded with Shima's gold.

routes.name: Cpl. Joe Griffin
routes.note: Joe wakes to the Pearl Harbor attack, loses his brother at Calumpit Bridge and raids Guadalcanal, then turns OSS agent chasing Shima's gold through Singapore, Burma and Thailand.
